title: MetaTax-eDNA: taxonomic profiling workflow for shotgun eDNA metagenomes
description:
MetaTax-eDNA is a modular Bash workflow for shotgun metagenomic DNA (eDNA) sequencing data from benthic and other environmental samples. It performs quality control (FastQC, MultiQC), adapter trimming (fastp), taxonomic classification of paired-end reads (Kraken2), domain summaries (Bacteria, Archaea, Nematoda, unclassified), taxid-based filtering and genus- and species-level OTU tables in base R, with timestamped logging and step-wise execution.

Developed in the Marine Biology Research Group, Ghent University, within the BELSPO/JPI Oceans project ORCHESTRA.
